note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after 4ef90497c6). Section 4.9: "Reason indicates why the session was closed." The earlier finding (no unit tied a Reason to the cause, and peerDownFor never emitted reason 4) is fixed and now proven at both decision points. Reactor: TestPeerCloseNamesTheTransportLoss drops TCP under a running Peer and asserts rpc.ReasonTCPFailure with Event 18; TestPeerCloseNamesTheCongestionTeardownLocal drives congestionTeardownPeer and asserts rpc.ReasonLocalClose with Event 18, so ze closing the transport itself is not reported as the remote doing it. BMP: TestRFC7854PeerDownTransportLossIsReason4 asserts Reason 4 ("This includes any unexpected termination of the transport session") with no Data for rpc.ReasonTCPFailure. TestHandleSenderStatePeerDown (reason 2 for a NOTIFICATION close with no cached PDU) and TestBMPSenderPeerDown (round-trips a chosen byte) remain weak on their own. Seam not covered by a tagged unit: apiStateObserver.OnPeerClosed and server/events.go copying the reason and CloseFSMEvent into the StructuredEvent. Single-polarity annotation holds: every Peer Down is written with a reason byte.
